input.summary: Ported matrix_rotate.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/matrix_rotate.dp.cpp. The file has no dpct includes, helpers, or DPCT_* macros (grep confirmed). It uses a sycl::queue (in-order), sycl::malloc_device/free, and a 1-D nd_range<1> parallel_for with the original per-layer rotation loop and the layer < n/2 guard. Compiles cleanly with icpx -fsycl and add_dpct_include=false (0 warnings). Output correctness: a serial C++ reference (same rotation applied repeat times) produced byte-identical binary output via cmp for n=2048/repeat=3, 512/1, 1000/2, 1/3, 2/1, 7/5. Caveat: the CUDA original was not built or run here, so equivalence is established against a serial reimplementation of the same loop, not the CUDA binary itself.
